rationale: Papers 2309.12644 and 2310.07133 provide estimates and constraints on the maximum mass of neutron stars, contributing evidence to the question. Paper 2311.13805 discusses a scenario requiring a higher maximum mass, while 2403.03399 explores modifications to general relativity that could allow for heavier neutron stars. These contributions provide substantive evidence but do not fully resolve the conflicting mass measurements from GW170817 and GW190814.
